name: @ahegyes/wordpress-plugins
description: DWS WordPress plugins monorepo — the shared test environment and the plugins' fan-outs.

scripts.setup: npm run packages-install:all && npm run plugins:build
scripts.packages-install:all: composer packages-install && composer plugins:packages-install && npm run packages-install && npm run plugins:packages-install
scripts.packages-update:all: composer packages-update && composer plugins:packages-update && npm run packages-update && npm run plugins:packages-update && npm run packages-update:wp && npm run plugins:packages-update:wp
scripts.plugins:packages-install: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-install && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-install
scripts.plugins:packages-update: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-update && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-update
scripts.plugins:packages-update:wp: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-update:wp && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-update:wp
scripts.plugins:build: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run build && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run build
scripts.plugins:test:e2e: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run test:e2e && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run test:e2e
